title: Repeat a small rule
summary: An @each loop makes one rule for each item in a list.
introduction: An @each loop makes one rule for each item in a list. Your task: Add 4 to the list and predict the new margin.
learningObjectives: Add 4 to the list and predict the new margin.
Explain the example for repeat a small rule

blocks.text: An @each loop makes one rule for each item in a list. It saves repeated typing when the rule shape stays the same.
Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
Read the code step by step

items: `@each` repeats its body for each value in the list. `#{...}` inserts a value into a generated selector name.

blocks.text: The output has space-1 with 4px, space-2 with 8px and space-3 with 12px margins.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The #{} form inserts a value into a selector name. Do not generate hundreds of unused classes.

blocks.text: Add 4 to the list and predict the new margin.
